failure_definition.sequence_failure: free-running selected tokens or stop reason differ

provenance.aggregate_verdict_note: The exploratory contract requires 32 cases; the holdout has 16, so its aggregate verdict is INCONCLUSIVE by case count. The study uses per-case labels computed directly from archived logits, not the aggregate verdict.

host_cost_secondary.interpretation: host timing only; differences are small and not an RVV cost conclusion

hardening.limitation: Sites are translation units, not individual reduction instructions. The clean build uses a compiler launcher to apply fast contraction everywhere except ggml-cpu/ops.cpp.

minimality.reason: the empty hardening set is the global fast build, which fails the same contract

hardening.scope: translation-unit selective hardening on ARM64; not RVV hardware

blocked_or_deferred.reason: Rostam was probed safely; standard RVV probe raised SIGILL. No compatible primary-board mechanism validation.
No full-model execution on a compatible RVV 1.0 target.
QEMU returned identical ordered and unordered results on 20,000 deterministic trials; the bounded negative result is reported but earns no attribution credit.
Model-level instruction attribution requires full-model RVV execution, which is unavailable.
No second conformant implementation or board is available.
Host-only timing is recorded, but it is not RVV evidence and does not support a defensible cost conclusion.
Final report written; external reproduction and independent review are unavailable.

progress.scope: host/emulator software milestone; physical-board and full-model RVV qualification pending
